local_dishes.name: Poisson Cru au lait de coco
local_dishes.description: Raw fish marinated in coconut milk and lime; similar to ceviche but with a creamy twist
local_dishes._source_file: French Polynesia/French Polynesia All Inclusive Guide - Apeksha and Nitin(1).docx

local_dishes.name: Poulet fafa
local_dishes.description: Chicken cooked with taro leaves and coconut milk, often prepared in a traditional underground oven (ahima'a) giving a smoky, earthy flavor
local_dishes._source_file: French Polynesia/French Polynesia All Inclusive Guide - Apeksha and Nitin(1).docx

local_dishes.name: Po'e
local_dishes.description: Sweet, starchy pudding made from taro, banana or pumpkin, cooked in an ahima'a and served with coconut cream
local_dishes._source_file: French Polynesia/French Polynesia All Inclusive Guide - Apeksha and Nitin(1).docx

local_dishes.name: Fafaru
local_dishes.description: Fish marinated in fermented seawater with crushed shrimp; strong aroma and flavor, an acquired taste
local_dishes._source_file: French Polynesia/French Polynesia All Inclusive Guide - Apeksha and Nitin(1).docx

local_dishes.name: Pahua Taioro
local_dishes.description: Clams soaked in fresh water for a few hours and combined with taioro, a condiment of fermented almonds, grated coconut, seawater and shrimps
local_dishes._source_file: French Polynesia/French Polynesia All Inclusive Guide - Apeksha and Nitin(1).docx

local_dishes.name: Firi Firi
local_dishes.description: Tahitian doughnuts made with flour, coconut milk and sugar, deep-fried; a popular breakfast treat often served with fruit or jam
local_dishes._source_file: French Polynesia/French Polynesia All Inclusive Guide - Apeksha and Nitin(1).docx

local_dishes.name: Chevrettes
local_dishes.description: Freshwater prawns, a local delicacy, grilled or cooked in a sauce of vanilla, coconut milk, rum and cream
local_dishes._source_file: French Polynesia/French Polynesia All Inclusive Guide - Apeksha and Nitin(1).docx

local_dishes.name: Breadfruit
local_dishes.description: Staple fruit that can be roasted, boiled or fried; starchy texture and mild flavor
local_dishes._source_file: French Polynesia/French Polynesia All Inclusive Guide - Apeksha and Nitin(1).docx

local_dishes.name: Coconut Crab
local_dishes.description: Large land crab prized for its rich and flavorful meat
local_dishes._source_file: French Polynesia/French Polynesia All Inclusive Guide - Apeksha and Nitin(1).docx
